integrity: The theorem follows from an explicit orbit-trace argument, a published all-parameter Euler recurrence, and a known integral sphere type; finite independent-face computations corroborate those mathematical steps without replacing them.
scientific_limitations: The rational alternating character is virtual for n other than two; no separately graded module classification, equivariant homotopy type, or priority claim is asserted.
title: Arm-permutation Lefschetz characters of the Braun–Hough comb complexes
